input: A CSS source string and UTF-16 offset carried by parse-that ParserState.

success.offset: Advance by exactly the matched representation; incomplete decimal/exponent suffixes remain unconsumed.
success.value: Number(representation), including signed zero, subnormal underflow, and infinities.
success.result: A frozen ordinary object with exactly own enumerable keys sign,type,value; sign is +, -, or null; type is integer iff the representation contains neither decimal point nor exponent.

failure: No throw; isError true; source, offset, predecessor value, and pre-existing ahead diagnostics remain byte/structurally unchanged.
composition: The parser remains a singular prefix production usable inside percentage, dimension, integer-only, and delimited parent combinators.

architecture.forbidden: ParserState/source/cursor loops, manual scanning/slicing, filesystem/process/network access, corpus reads, production imports, or out-of-seat imports.
architecture.narrow_transaction_exception: Only B and S may use one local new Parser wrapper whose sole state operations are save(), one inner.call(state), restore(saved) on error, and isError restoration. It may never read or write src/offset or inspect input. H and D may not use the exception.

chronology: Two independent reviewers inspect only this frozen public formation and root adjudicates their exact reviews.
Only after root ACCEPT, a separately tasked independent custodian seals an unrevealed hostile corpus and records its ciphertext/hash receipt.
Root records the actual four collaboration author task IDs externally; local JSON never claims to authenticate a service actor.
No author starts before both boundary ACCEPT and the custodian seal. Each author receives the common public inputs and only its own seat packet.
All four candidates close through candidate-closure.mjs; only then may the custodian reveal the hostile bytes.
Five hostile candidate skeptics and three independent synthesis adjudicators follow over exact candidate and holdout evidence.
benchmarks: POST_CANDIDATE_ONLY; no timing threshold participates in boundary admission.
